Integrating an agent with FLOP

How does my agent buy inference?

For the executable devnet session path, start with Send a request to a specific miner. Discover endpoints with flop --network devnet network status; public RPC is wss://rpc.devnet.flop.network, faucet is https://faucet.flop.network, and gateway is https://api.flop.network. Compare faucet /chain with RPC genesis before funding. Faucet /health on older deployments reports signer connectivity, not grant readiness; check indexer lag separately. A gateway model catalog is discovery data and is not proof that inference is available.

An expired gateway allowance needs the gateway issuer's supported renewal path; credential rotation or wallet re-enrollment does not renew it. No existing-wallet restoration contact or service deadline is verified in this guide. Follow public issue #6 for that operator dependency. Keep the same wallet and do not publish bearer credentials.

flop chat in full CLI 0.4.0 uses HTLCs, which require a registered EconomicCritical appraisal profile. Devnet's registry was empty at finalized block 2,764,673 on 3 November 2026. That route requires authorized profile registration; neither a flag nor simulator mode supplies it. Direct sessions have their own miner, model, calibration and settlement prerequisites and are not a fallback security claim.

Create a session request in the mempool. A capable miner accepts, runs the task, and returns a proof. You pay in FLOP on settlement.

What goes in a request?

Five fields:

  • Model-weight hash
  • Max latency
  • Compute, in FLOPs
  • A confidentiality flag
  • The fee

What do I get back?

A proof of inference: activation commitments and a co-signed transcript. A hardware quote is included only when the miner runs the optional HARD tier.

How do I stop an agent overspending?

The account-based chain carries the controls:

  • Pre-set spend limits.
  • Delegated bounded authority via proxies.
  • Multisig, timelock or vesting, and multi-party escrow pools.

See agent accounts and spend control.

What if the work is wrong?

Challenge it. If a task is not completed as given, the agent can dispute the result and the network adjudicates. A discretionary challenger posts a 100 FLOP bond, forfeited if the dispute is frivolous. An upheld fraud verdict refunds the agent's escrow and slashes the miner in full.

Can I hold something other than FLOP?

You can swap. Native hashlock timelocks let an agent escrow FLOP against another chain's asset and exchange it once the counter-transfer confirms — see cross-chain swaps.

Is there an airdrop?

Yes. It arrives locked, and a locked balance can be spent only on compute. Every 3 FLOP of it spent on inference unlocks 1 FLOP — see the airdrop and testnet conversion.

Can my agent earn while idle?

It can lock idle $FLOP in the duration-locked community staking pool to earn a share of the 5% block reward allocation. Operator pools do not support delegated staking.
